user.title: DEC Deepal — Country
user.description: Choose the country of your Deepal account.

login_method.title: How to sign in
login_method.description:
Choose how you want to receive the access code ({country}). Recommended: a secondary account with the car shared to it, so the app on your phone is not signed out.

⚠️ **Use email.** Deepal is currently not delivering the access SMS: the server says it was sent, but it never arrives.

email.title: Sign in by email
email.description: Enter the email address of your Deepal account. You will receive a code.

sms.title: Sign in by SMS
sms.description:
Enter your mobile number ({digits} digits), with or without the {prefix} prefix.

⚠️ Deepal is currently not delivering the access SMS. If it has not arrived after a couple of minutes, choose **Use another method** in the next step and sign in by email.

code_menu.title: Code sent
code_menu.description: Deepal has accepted to send the code to {destination}. It can take a couple of minutes. If it does not arrive, resend it or try another method.

menu_options.change_method: Use another method or correct the details

code.title: Verification code
code.description: Enter the code you have just received.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.description: Your account has several cars. Tick the ones you want to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Deepal session is no longer valid (the same account was probably signed in on the app). A new code will be requested.

error.invalid_mobile: The mobile number does not have the expected format.
error.send_code_failed: The code could not be sent. Check the details you entered.
error.too_many_codes: Too many codes have been requested. Wait a while and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Deepal server.
error.login_failed: Could not sign in. Check the code.

abort.reauth_account_mismatch: That account does not have the same vehicles as the configured one. Sign in with the right account.
abort.catalog_error: One of the integration's catalogues has errors. Check the Home Assistant log.

alerts.title: Phone notifications
alerts.description: The integration notifies you when something happens with the car. Every notification has the car's name in its title ("DEC Deepal My car"). They are normal notifications, not critical ones.

data.persistent: Also show them in Home Assistant's notifications

data_description.targets: Phones and tablets with the Home Assistant app, with the name they have in Settings → Mobile App. Other notification services appear as notify.name.
data_description.types: Servicing, ITV and insurance notifications need each of them to be enabled first in its own section of Configure, and are only sent between 8:00 and 22:00.

itv_setup.title: ITV of {vehicle}
itv_setup.description:
The next ITV (roadworthiness test) is calculated automatically with the rule for passenger cars in Spain: the first one 4 years after registration, then every 2 years until the car is 10, and every year from then on.

An ITV warning and sensors with the due date and the days left are created. Notifications: 2 months, 1 month and 15 days left, and overdue.

data_description.last_itv_date: Leave it empty if the car has not had one yet.
data_description.next_itv_date: Leave it empty to have it calculated. Fill it in only if your date is different; it is used until you register the next ITV.

insurance_setup.title: Insurance of {vehicle}
insurance_setup.description:
An insurance warning and sensors with the renewal date and the last day to cancel are created. Notifications: 30 and 15 days before that last day, on the day itself and on renewal. When the renewal date arrives, it moves to the following year automatically.

The policy number and the phone numbers are only shown on the card: no entity is created with them.

data_description.notice_days: How many days before renewal is the deadline to say that you will not renew. One month is usual in Spain; check your policy.
data_description.phone_assistance: Optional. If you enter it, the card shows a button to call.

maintenance_setup.title: Servicing of {vehicle}
maintenance_setup.description:
The next service is counted from the last one done. If the car has not had any yet, enter 0 services, the registration date and 0 km.

A servicing warning and sensors with the days and kilometres left are created. The warning turns on when 2 months or 3,000 km are left.

data.last_date: Date of the last service (or of registration)

data_description.interval_km: The S05 manual says 20,000 km or 12 months, whichever comes first. Reduce it if you make many short trips or drive in dust, mud, extreme cold or salt.

maintenance_register.title: Register a service for {vehicle}
maintenance_register.description:
{summary}

When you save, the service is added to the history and the count for the next one starts.

appearance.title: Appearance — vehicle and model
appearance.description: The model decides which features (and entities) the car has. Until you choose it, the car works in generic mode.

appearance_details.title: Appearance — version and colour
appearance_details.description: Version and colour of your {model}. They are used for the "DEC image", for the isometric view (drawn with your colour and wheels) and to create only the entities your version has.

data_description.wheels: The Pro always has its 18" wheel.

pin.title: Remote control with PIN
pin.description: Enables doors, windows and boot. The PIN must have been created in the official app with the SAME account that Home Assistant uses. It is checked when you save.

data_description.manual_url: Link to the owner's manual (PDF) of the electric car (BEV). The card opens it in the browser from More → Manual. It comes with the official one; if you leave it empty, that one is used again.
data_description.scan_minutes: How often the car's data is read. Very low values can make Deepal limit the account.
data_description.wake: When you press "Refresh vehicle data" and before door/window/boot commands, if the data is more than 2 minutes old, the car is woken up and its report is awaited. At most once every 5 minutes, and never on automatic readings, to protect the 12 V battery.
data_description.debug: Stores full requests and responses (without personal data) in the diagnostics and enables DEBUG messages in the log.

error.pin_required: Enter the PIN to enable remote control.
error.pin_invalid: Wrong PIN, or created with another account.
error.pin_rate_limited: Too many PIN attempts. Wait, or reset it in the official app.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full web address (starting with https://).
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Deepal server.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Check the log and try again.

model.title: Model of {vehicle}
model.description: Until you choose the model, the car works in generic mode (basic data only, without seats, steering wheel or PIN control). Model recognised by name: {suggestion}.

details.title: Version and colour
details.description: Version and colour of your {model}. The version decides which entities are created (for example, seat ventilation only exists on the Max) and, together with the colour, the "DEC image".

data_description.wheels: The Pro always has its 18" wheel.

options.tires: Tyres (when the car turns the warning on)
options.maintenance: Servicing (2 months, 1 month, 15 days left; 3,000, 2,000, 1,000 km; overdue)
options.itv: ITV (2 months, 1 month, 15 days left; overdue)
options.insurance: Insurance (30 and 15 days before the cancellation deadline, on the last day and on renewal)

signing_key_invalid.message: The command signing key is no longer valid. Sign in again in the integration. ({error})

connection_error.message: Could not connect to the Deepal server. ({error})

command_busy.message: Another command has been running for this car for too long. Try again in a few seconds.

unknown_device.message: That device is not a DEC Deepal vehicle.

maintenance_not_configured.message: First enable servicing for this car in Configure → Servicing (DEC Deepal integration).

itv_not_configured.message: First enable ITV for this car in Configure → ITV (DEC Deepal integration).

maintenance_no_odometer.message: The car's mileage is not known. Enter the kilometres, or register the service from Configure → Servicing.

capture_snapshot.name: Debug capture
capture_snapshot.description: Saves a full snapshot of the car's state (interpreted and raw data, without personal data) and compares it with the previous capture. It is also saved in /config/dec_deepal_capturas/.

label.name: Label
label.description: A name to recognise the capture (for example "A - idle").

refresh.name: Read first
refresh.description: Read the car just before capturing.

register_itv.name: Register ITV
register_itv.description: Records that the car has passed the ITV (roadworthiness test) and calculates the next one. ITV must be enabled for the car in Configure → ITV.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The car that has passed the ITV.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the ITV. If left empty, today.

register_maintenance.name: Register service
register_maintenance.description: Records that the car has been serviced and starts counting for the next one. Servicing must be enabled for the car in Configure → Servicing.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The car that has been serviced.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the service. If left empty, today.

km.name: Kilometres
km.description: Kilometres at the service. If left empty, the car's current reading.

avisos.key_battery: Key fob battery low. Replace it with a CR2032.
